title: Core menu
summary: A walk through the Core menu

steps.say: Dashboard. Your command center: KPI cards for the lead pipeline, the stage funnel, top-scored leads and the recent activity feed.
Executive Overview. How outreach is converting across the company, with cards, bars and rows you can click to dig into the detail.
Pipeline Board. The campaign board: one column per stage, one card per lead with its score and latest activity, plus filters by state, program, minimum score and sort order.
Map View. Leads plotted on a map so you can see where properties are and open one from its pin.
Field View (Mobile). A phone-friendly view for working leads in the field: touch a pin to see the lead, with call-quality feedback and assignment override.
Time Clock. Clock in and out and track your breaks.
Team Chat. Message your team inside AVYRO.
My Profile & Prefs. Your own profile and preferences.
System Health. Live status checks of every AVYRO service, with a 90-day history you can click into by day.
AVA Knowledge. Teach AVA answers for your team and see what she could not answer

Integration Health. Whether each connected service (sync sources, messaging, email) is up and responding.
CSV Pre-Flight. Validate a CSV before import

Data Quality Monitor. Ongoing data-quality checks across the lead database and how they trend.
Verification Debug. Trace any property through the verification pipeline to see why it did or did not pass.
